content: Leaf's Lookout- Leaf's new home based on a real tree from from my childhood family camp (I have some pictures too!). A wide tree that once was thought rotten and long dead now  has bright green leaves despite missing most of the center of it's trunk. There's an opening in the tree just big enough for most to duck into and stand inside. Here they can look all the way up through the tree to the sky where the branches open up. Those willing can climb up the tunnel to look out the top of the tree through the branches and green leaves. The tunnel is just big enough to happily fit a small goblin and her trinkets. Preferably, it's not far from the other treehouses and can be connected by a bridge or nice path. Eventually there will be a platform at the top so others can visit and watch the stars, and maybe even a swing to commemorate the real life tree.

Leaf wanders around, feeling a tug at her heart. She wants to find a tree to call home. Not like the ones back in the Old World, where'd she'd go from tree to tree, grateful for their protection but scared all the same. This was going to be *her* tree. Her home. With the tree's permission of course. Finally, she stops in a small clearing by Wynne and Cato's treehouse. A large tree stands, branches wide in welcoming, literally open to her. She rushes to it and gives the tree a hug. "Thank you! We'll take good care of each other I promise!". She finds a hole in the tree and sits inside, smiling. Looking up through the inside of the tree she can see the blue sky smiling back as well. From inside Leaf works happily to grow soft flowers to decorate her new home, talking idly with the tree as she does.

After a while, the entrance to the tree is completely outlined in flowers and leaves growing up the side, creating a wreath doorway of sorts. She steps out to examine her work and gives it an approving nod. She goes back inside and begins pulling things out of her pockets, arranging her collection of gifts along the tree's naturally created shelves. Things like the preserved flower from Web and most of the letters she received while on the sub. She also arranges the stars Copper made her along the sides of the tree, casting Light on afew to see where to best place them. Leaf climbs up the inside of the tree and peeks her head out the top, assessing how easily her friends could get up here, and how large to build the platform without overwhelming the tree. She beams and tests the names out loud, "Leaf's Lookout.". Finally, she finds a place to empty her box of calligrapher's tools and situates the empty wooden box at the tree's roots along with some inviting flowers. She leaves a small piece of paper on the top: *Leaf not around? Leave a note!*
